text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono didn't show up for training,
so I went looking for her based on
eyewitness accounts...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Mmm~! The new macaron parfait is crispy, melty, and so very buono☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I didn't know you could combine ingredients like this~.
I'll use this as inspiration and make some for everyone next time!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
And then~, which shops haven't I tried
the new sweets at yet~...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
choice_data_list: ...Training time is already up, you know.
...Training time is already up, you know.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ah, aaah~! I'm so sorry!
I forgot to look at the clock...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I gave a stern warning to be more careful
in the future...
